newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Natural Gas details structural review.
newsitem.headline: Natural Gas details structural review.

text.p: Natural Gas Corporation on Wednesday announced organisational changes within its high pressure gas transmission operations as part of a comprehensive structural review of the company.

Chief Executive Richard Bentley said the changes, to be fully effective from February 14, would complete the process of separating the management of the New Plymouth based Transmission Group, including the provision of contract gas transportation services, from all other areas of the company's business.

At the same time, they would further streamline the transmission operations, achieving enhanced efficiencies and ensuring the company continue to offer the most cost-effective gas transportation services to customers.

Transmission Group staffing requirements would fall to 72 from 100 as a result of a change which involved a major reorganisation of gas control, easement management and pipeline operation functions, the closure of the Frankton, Hamilton, field office, plus greater use of external services for projects and some business support functions.
Formerly part of the Taranaki Operations Division, which also included the Kapuni gas treatment plant, the Transmission Group was now completely stand-alone.
